name: Sado-Yahiko-Yoneyama Quasi-National Park
nameJa: 佐渡弥彦米山国定公園
aliases: 佐渡弥彦米山国定公園
description: Quasi-national park linking Sado Island, Mt. Yahiko and Mt. Yoneyama — the holy mountains of the coast and the island's sea cliffs and gold-mine history.
notes: Managed by Niigata. Yahiko's shrine forest and Sado's coast roads are the highlights.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)

ja.notes: 新潟県管理。弥彦山の社叢と佐渡の海岸道路がハイライト。
